title: Discrete Structure (BIT11003)
description: UTHM BIT11003/BIC10103 Discrete Structure: practice questions built from the tutorial sheets and lecture slides, covering propositions and logic, conjunctive and disjunctive normal forms, predicates and quantifiers, and mathematical induction.

lab.label: Logic lab
lab.note: Complete truth tables, normal forms, quantifier statements and induction steps by filling the gaps. Symbol choices come from dropdowns; typed gaps need the value or expression exactly as authored, because equivalent but differently written answers may not be recognized.
